answer: A farm can plant a thousand lookouts on every mesa ridge before noon. To run one haven trail, escrow 8.60 POA for 15 hours and register a single 33-byte calibration curve for one opal flake probe tied to a single trailhead. The runner must collect six cairn stamps, 40 seconds apart, each signing the flake curve xor a trailhead-minute nonce, all from that mesa. Four rangers replay the stamps and admit one live trail per curve. If two probes share a curve, a stamp goes backward, or one bond covers two trailheads, 3.15 POA burns and the cluster is held off that haven for ten epochs.
